front.title: Domain Name System (DNS) Public Key Based Request and Transaction Authentication (MSGSIG, SIG(0))

abstract.t: This document specifies the MSGSIG and SIG(0) Domain Name System (DNS) Resource Records (RRs) which provide public key based authentication of DNS requests and transactions. MSGSIG is the RECOMMENDED option. This document obsoletes RFC 2931 and updates RFC 6891.
